decisions.reason: Adding client-provided B-roll as a required source does not alter the complete-moment standard; the separate audience-comprehension clause already has its own same-message Event.
Requiring B-roll alongside long-form footage does not change the existing clean-editing, effects, or transition rules.
The source-selection change does not affect the existing 45-to-60-second duration requirement, which the message only restates.
Adding B-roll as a clip source does not change the caption color, font, or effects requirements.
The source-selection decision does not change the approval gate; the batch-specific approval timing is an independent clause already represented by a same-message Event.
Using B-roll does not alter publishing eligibility or destination; the Friday schedule and late-delivery policy are separate decisions already represented.
The five-clip B-roll batch is task-specific and does not modify the deferred monthly quota of 100 approved clips.
The source-selection change does not logically alter submission mechanics; the Google Drive, batch-size, and deadline changes are independent clauses already captured by a same-message Event.
Access to and required use of B-roll for the current production batch does not change the completed qualification process.
The source decision changes permitted and required footage sources but does not establish a new strong or impactful moment-selection criterion.
The clip-source update has no necessary effect on Lead Clipper responsibilities, training, or advancement.
The B-roll source requirement does not establish or modify any progress or delay communication obligation.
